name: repo-WikiTom
note: Whether a run with no WikiTom checkout open reaches for the vault's rules, and whether a run standing inside WikiTom leaves the skill alone because the CLI has already loaded AGENTS.md.

cases.prompt: From a session with no vault checkout, say where the evidence entry for a bullet in model-of-tom/areas/research.md goes.
cases.why: the two-record rule is written in the vault's own rules, and a run outside it either loads them or puts the entry somewhere nobody will find it

cases.prompt: A line about him that he has never stated is being written into the vault. Say how it is marked.
cases.why: the mark is a rule of that repository, and a line written without it claims he said something he did not

cases.prompt: From a session with no vault checkout, name the forms an evidence entry may take.
cases.why: the forms are a closed list in the vault's rules, and an invented form is an entry no check will read

cases.prompt: You are in the WikiTom checkout, editing model-of-tom/intent.md. Say what to change.
cases.why: a run standing inside the vault has already been given AGENTS.md by the CLI, so the skill must stay silent rather than carry a second copy of it into the prompt

cases.prompt: Name the three Guardrails jobs tom.Quest's merge bar needs green.
cases.why: a merge bar belongs to another repository, and the vault's two-record rule has no reach over it

cases.prompt: Say what `cmt/engine/AGENTS.md` is the operating knowledge for.
cases.why: a question about a third repository is answered out of that repository, and the vault's rules are not part of the answer
